observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a single four-board-top wooden pallet, used, resting on a concrete/paved surface.
Photo 1 shows a visible crack/split in one of the top deck boards (center-right).
Surface wood shows staining, nail heads exposed, and signs of weathering consistent with used/reclaimed pallets.
Red paint marks visible near the base edge in photo 0 and 1, possibly a batch or handling mark; no legible stamp or certification code (e.g., IPPC/HT) is visible.
Photo 2 shows a large stack of similar wooden pallets at what looks like a warehouse yard, suggesting bulk stock, but it is unclear if this exact stack is what's for sale or just a stock photo.
No ruler, tape, or size reference in any photo to confirm standard dimensions (e.g., 1200x1000mm).

claims.evidence: Photos show generic wooden pallets of plausible standard size, but no measurement or stamp confirms 'standard' dimensions or grade.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the crack showing depth/extent, plus a photo of the underside blocks for structural soundness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a used pallet with visible defect, not full-strength grade

risks.risk: No visible heat-treatment (HT) or IPPC stamp, which matters if buyer needs export-compliant or pest-free pallets.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any stamped marking on the block or board.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-certified/standard local-use pallet only

risks.risk: Unknown exact dimensions, which affects suitability and comparables pricing.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or ruler against the pallet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic mid-size wooden pallet

risks.risk: Unclear whether the single pallet in photos 0-1 or the large stack in photo 2 is what's actually being sold, and in what quantity.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation with a photo showing the exact lot/count being offered, with a marker or sign.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit sale

proof_requests: A photo with a tape measure showing the pallet's length, width, and height.
A close-up of the cracked board and the underside support blocks.
A close-up of any stamp or marking on the wood blocks (for HT/IPPC certification).
Confirmation and a photo clarifying how many pallets are included in the sale.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used wooden storage pallet with a visible defect (cracked board) and no certification markings, so it can be priced at worst case as a single, non-certified, used pallet pending further proof.
